name: unity-drop-web

unityDrop.mission: Provide an intuitive, fast, and accessible digital portal for the Unity Drop community.
unityDrop.problem: Generic blood donation platforms are often clunky on mobile and lack clear user flows for donors and patients.
unityDrop.solution: A premium Next.js 15 interface with optimized React 19 portals for Admin, Donor, and Patient roles.
unityDrop.impact: Delivers a state-of-the-art user experience with real-time feedback and smooth animations.
features: Dynamic data visualizations for blood stats

description: Premium Next.js frontend for Unity Drop Blood Donation Management System. Built with React 19, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion for a high-performance, responsive user experience across Donor, Patient, and Admin portals.
